title: Design a Payment System (Stripe/PayPal)
subtitle: Idempotence keys, double-entry bookkeeping ledgers, and 2PC reconciliation loops

stages.title: Stage 1 — Direct Payment Gateway Call
stages.bottleneck: Network timeout during Stripe call leaves transaction status ambiguous (Did money leave user account? Should order fulfill?).
stages.narrative: **Synchronous Payment Call.** Direct inline call to payment processor without state persistence or transaction boundary.

stages.title: Stage 2 — Idempotent Payment Service & Double-Entry Ledger
stages.bottleneck: Single-entry balances (`balance = balance - 50`) suffer from audit discrepancies and corrupted money totals.
stages.narrative:
**Idempotency & Double-Entry Ledger.**
1. **Idempotency Key:** If user double-clicks submit button, Redis lock prevents double charging.
2. **Double-Entry Bookkeeping:** Every transaction records equal debit and credit entries (`sum(debits) - sum(credits) == 0`). Money is never created or destroyed out of thin air.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Async Settlement & Nightly Reconciliation Loop
stages.bottleneck: Gateway webhooks can drop; bank settlement files arrive 24h later with mismatched totals.
stages.narrative: **Reconciliation Loop.** Nightly cron jobs download bank settlement files, match line items against the internal double-entry ledger, and alert human operators on mismatch.
